content.value_statement: Teams need consistent NGX copy that matches the Verdad Directa voice. This skill gives audience rules, voice modes, and review checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use NGX brand voice guidance for copywriting.
Supports adapting content for 30-45 and 45-60 age segments.
Defines a three-step conversion formula: confront, support, resolve.
Helps validate existing copy against a pre-publication checklist.
Points users to voice guide, mode examples, audience adaptation, agent voices, and checklist materials.
limitations: Only SKILL.md is present in the analyzed package, so referenced guide files may be unavailable.
It does not execute checks or enforce brand rules automatically.
It focuses on NGX brand voice, not general marketing strategy.
It does not include legal, medical, or compliance review.

use_cases.title: Draft Campaign Copy
use_cases.description: Create NGX messages that follow the selected voice mode and audience segment.

use_cases.title: Adapt Product Messaging
use_cases.description: Rewrite existing text for a specific age segment while keeping the NGX voice consistent.

use_cases.title: Review Pre-Publication Copy
use_cases.description: Check draft copy against the stated brand voice process before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Basic Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a short NGX message for [audience] about [offer]. Use the Verdad Directa voice and choose mode [A, B, or C].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new copy draft

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Existing Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this draft for the 45-60 audience segment. Keep the NGX voice direct, clear, and practical.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request to tailor existing copy

prompt_templates.title: Review Brand Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate the following NGX copy against the pre-publication checklist. Identify voice mismatches and rewrite weak sections.

prompt_templates.title: Build Campaign Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three NGX campaign variants for [offer]. Use different communication modes and explain which audience each variant fits.

output_examples.input: Draft a concise NGX acquisition message for the 30-45 audience.
output_examples.output: A direct headline, a grounded reason to care, and a practical next step for the reader.

output_examples.input: Validate this NGX draft for brand fit before publication.
output: Voice mismatches are identified in direct terms.
The rewrite uses a clearer promise and a practical next step.

best_practices: State the audience age segment before asking for copy.
Name the communication mode when the campaign has a specific intent.
Run final copy through the checklist before publication.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for brands outside NGX without adapting the guidance.
Asking for generic marketing copy without audience or objective context.
Treating generated copy as compliance-approved final text.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create and review NGX copy aligned with the Verdad Directa brand voice.

faq.question: Can it adapt copy for different audiences?
faq.answer: Yes. SKILL.md describes audience adaptation for 30-45 and 45-60 age segments.

faq.question: Does it include automatic validation tools?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for review, but it does not run automated checks.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Is it limited to NGX content?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is written for NGX brand voice and may need changes for other brands.

faq.question: Does it provide final compliance approval?
faq.answer: No. Human review is still required for legal, medical, and compliance-sensitive claims.
